تمتروا (form VIII)
# تَمْتَرُوا (tamtarū) /tam.ta.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
# تُمْتَرَوْا (tumtaraw) /tum.ta.raw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
